content.text:
I added `transformEventStep` in `nodejs/src/ingestion/common/event-pipeline/transformEventStep.ts`. It hasn't been linted, type-checked or tested: the oxlint and `tsc` commands needed approval I didn't get, and I didn't add a test.

Most of the ingestion/CDP split was already in place when I started. Ingestion code sits under `src/ingestion/`, shared code sits under `src/common/`, and a lint rule stops ingestion from importing `~/cdp`. The only missing piece was this step, so the new file is the whole change.

- **What it does:** it takes a plugin event and a hog transformer. With no transformer it returns `{ event, invocationResults: [] }`, the event unchanged with no invocation results. Otherwise it returns the result of `hogTransformer.transformEventAndProduceMessages(event)`.
- **Staying out of CDP:** the transformer and result types come from `~/common/hog-transformations/hog-transformer.interface`, not from `~/cdp`, so it passes the no-CDP-imports rule. The transformer parameter only requires `transformEventAndProduceMessages`, the same shape as the existing `createHogTransformEventStep`.

To check it, run `oxlint -c nodejs/.oxlintrc.nodejs.json` on the new folder and `tsc --noEmit` in `nodejs/`.
